noIndexer: Searching needs at least one indexer that is switched on.
title: Search
intro: nexcrate asks every indexer that is switched on, checks every release against the profile of every version and shows what it would take. Nothing is downloaded until you press Download on a release.

load.wouldWait: The automatic would let this release wait until {{date}}. By hand it loads at once.
load.label: Download for {{label}}: {{title}}
load.started: Downloading. You can follow the progress under Downloads.

block.version_fed_by_source: A connection feeds {{label}}. nexcrate only downloads for versions without a connection.
block.version_no_folder: {{label}} has no default folder yet. Without one nexcrate does not know where the movie should go.
block.noClientUsenet: No download client for Usenet is switched on.
block.noClientTorrent: No download client for torrents is switched on.
block.download_active: A download for {{label}} is already running. A second one only works once it is filed away or removed.
block.waiting_for_delay: The best release for {{label}} is still waiting: the delay rule of the version gives a better one some time. It is listed under Downloads, tab Waiting.
block.unknown: Downloading this release does not work right now (code {{code}}).
block.unknownNoCode: Downloading this release does not work right now.
block.episodes_downloading: A running download of {{label}} already loads episodes of this release.

confirm.title: Download anyway?
confirm.notFitting: The release does not fit the profile of {{label}}.
confirm.blocklisted: The release is on the blocklist of this title. nexcrate does not download it without your confirmation.
confirm.noGain_one: Brings nothing new: replaces {{value}} existing file.
confirm.noGain_other: Brings nothing new: replaces {{value}} existing files.

running: The search is running. It is done after three minutes at the latest.

problems.notMovie: Searching only works for movies so far.
problems.titleGone: This title does not exist any more.
problems.expired: The result of this search is gone. nexcrate keeps a search for 30 minutes. Just start it again.

indexers.timeout: After three minutes nexcrate stopped waiting for this indexer.
indexers.internalError: Something went wrong in nexcrate while asking this indexer. The log has the details.

outcome.noProfileText: {{label}} has no profile yet. Without a profile nexcrate cannot judge any release.
outcome.firstPlace: It fits the profile and comes first in the order.
outcome.place: It fits the profile and is ranked {{rank}}. The fitting releases above it would be no improvement.
outcome.noFile: This version has no file yet.
outcome.better: It would be better than the existing file.
outcome.keepsText: No fitting release would be better than the existing file.
outcome.keepsNoneFits: No release fits the profile. The existing file stays.
outcome.noneFound: No indexer returned a release for this movie.

reasons.quality_not_allowed_one: {{value}} release in a quality the profile does not allow
reasons.quality_not_allowed_other: {{value}} releases in qualities the profile does not allow
reasons.protocol_disabled_one: {{value}} release in a protocol the version has switched off
reasons.protocol_disabled_other: {{value}} releases in a protocol the version has switched off
reasons.refused_form_one: {{value}} release in a form nexcrate does not take
reasons.refused_form_other: {{value}} releases in a form nexcrate does not take
reasons.season_incomplete_one: {{value}} season pack of a season that has not fully aired
reasons.season_incomplete_other: {{value}} season packs of seasons that have not fully aired
reasons.already_imported_one: {{value}} release that episodes came from already
reasons.already_imported_other: {{value}} releases that episodes came from already
reasons.older_than_retention_one: {{value}} release older than the news servers keep it
reasons.older_than_retention_other: {{value}} releases older than the news servers keep them

releases.title: Releases for {{label}}
releases.onlyFittingHint: Shows for each version only the releases that fit its profile.
releases.none: There are no releases for this movie.

other.intro: An indexer returned these releases, but by title or year they belong to another movie. nexcrate does not judge them.

problems.scope: This search does not fit this series. Reload the page and try again.

outcome.covered: {{codes}} already comes from a release above.
outcome.packLeftOut: Left out: a season pack that would bring only {{brings}} of {{episodes}} episodes. Equally good smaller releases do.
outcome.keepsText: No fitting release would be better than the files it has.
outcome.noneFound: No indexer delivered a release of this series.
outcome.noneFits: No release for the episodes searched fits the profile.
outcome.nothingToTakeText: There is nothing to take for the episodes searched. Maybe none of them is monitored.

releases.none: There are no releases of this series.
releases.loadLater: Downloading comes with a later version.
releases.otherReading: TMDB numbers this episode differently. Matched by: {{via}}.

other.intro: An indexer delivered these releases, but by number or title they belong to another series. nexcrate does not rate them.

series.seasonsNothingWatched_one: No version monitors an aired episode here. Searching shows the releases of the {{value}} aired season; nexcrate would take nothing.
series.seasonsNothingWatched_other: No version monitors an aired episode here. Searching shows the releases of all {{value}} aired seasons; nexcrate would take nothing.
series.seasonsNotAired: No episode of this series has aired yet.

takes.label: Download all for {{label}}
takes.title: Download all for {{label}}
takes.blocked: Not every release of the set can load right now. The reasons stand at the releases.
takes.done: Done. You see the progress under Downloads.

album.aliasesHint: Asks again, also with up to two further names of the artist from MusicBrainz.
album.oursNone: No release is of this album.
album.othersTitle: Of other albums of the artist

album.restTitle_other: Not of this artist or album ({{value}})
album.keeps: None of them is better than the album's files.

album.noneFound: No indexer delivered a release of this album.

match.unknownAlbumNoName: The artist, but no album of theirs.
match.sampler: A sampler, no album of this artist.
